article:
Our latest
Hidden Gems Punching Above Their Weight
event brought together more than 200 investors eager to uncover promising small-cap opportunities beyond the usual blue-chip names. If you couldn’t join us live, or simply want to revisit the discussion, the full event recording is now available.
Alongside the recording, this week’s Smart Reads explores practical ways to grow your passive income, from putting excess CPF savings to work and building a S$100,000 income portfolio to identifying dividend stocks beyond the STI.
We also examine the risks facing DBS, whether iFAST remains on track to meet its dividend ambitions, and how young investors can decide between high-interest savings and investing.
Here are this week’s top articles:
Event Recording: Hidden Gems Punching Above Their Weight
Missed our latest investing event? Catch the recording and discover the small-cap opportunities discussed by our team.
Dividends for Life: How to Turn Your CPF Excess into a Monthly Cash Machine
Learn how excess CPF savings could be transformed into a reliable stream of monthly passive income.
3 Blue-Chip REITs Acquiring to Grow Their DPU
These established REITs are using acquisitions to strengthen their portfolios and grow future distributions.
Can S$100,000 Generate Enough Passive Income in Singapore?
How far can a six-figure portfolio take you on your journey towards financial independence?
3 Looming Risks Every DBS Investor Should Watch
Even great businesses face challenges. Here’s what DBS shareholders should keep an eye on.
Beyond STI: 3 Singapore Dividend Stocks Offering Steady Passive Income
These dependable dividend stocks prove that attractive income opportunities can also be found beyond the STI.
High-Interest Savings vs Stocks: Where Should Young Professionals Park Their First S$20,000?
A practical comparison to help new investors decide how to put their first meaningful savings to work.

We assess whether the fintech’s upcoming results can support its ambitious dividend plans.
